claim: one pinned checkpoint, recorded inputs and intervention sites; reference implementations share intake but not forward computation
intervention_donors: same registered recipe using each engine's own measured baseline activations

tolerances.argmax_requirement: not a gate: numerical tolerance and near-tie margins are reported
tolerances.arithmetic: CPU float32; deterministic evaluation; eager attention; no KV cache
tolerances.baseline_cases: both inputs of all six cases, twelve full-logit arrays
tolerances.failure_policy: retain the failing comparison and stop interpretation; changing tolerances requires a separate declared experiment
tolerances.patch_donor_policy: each engine uses its own captured donor and recipient; baseline activation discrepancies are checked separately
